name: vfxmith
description: Make Roblox VFX like experienced artists do: a library of ~1,200 real open-source effects with their exact layer values and frame-by-frame sheets, 11 effect-type studies with starting recipes, a directed build loop (builder + director agents, tested building blocks, a 5-camera self-check), a data-driven effect runtime, Studio capture and blind review, and tools to study any VFX pack safely.
